note: O'Fallon campground 7 miles north of I-70, 25 minutes from historic St. Charles; RV rows beside two small ponds; pool, fitness center and dog park. --Claude
summary: Operator site (rates page modified 2026-04-09): $45 a day, $250 a week, $650 a month, FHU, phone only; showers, laundry, dump. Waterfront lead lakeview -> not waterfront: the two 'lakes' are ~3 acres each on imagery. Long-stay concern: imagery shows nearly every RV site filled and there is no engine to check nightly availability.
flags: WATERFRONT lead lakeview -> not waterfront: Esri imagery (500 m frame at 38.8805,-90.7265) shows the 'lakes' as two separate ponds east of the RV rows, the central one ~110 x 180 m irregular (~3 acres) and the eastern one ~85 x 170 m (~2.7 acres), plus a ~0.25-acre pond in the loop. Each is under the ~5-acre pond line, so no lake-view value.
PRICE GATE (private): posted rate $45 a night for 2 (rates page modified 2026-04-09) - under $50, passes. Good Sam: operator silent (none stored). Gateway not needed.

PRESENCE: operator site http://cherokeelakescampground.com/ (http only, current: 2026 rate page, Nov 2026 weather widget) confirmed as this park (O'Fallon, 636-978-2147); Google 4.4 stars, 305 reviews at 3942 MO-79. No booking engine.

LONG-STAY - CONCERN (weekly $250 and monthly $650 marketed; homepage 'Whether you're looking for a weekend getaway or in need of a longer stay'): (1) nightly price posted - pass; (2) no booking engine, but a posted nightly price and a phone line - pass; (3) marketing is mixed weekend/longer-stay in a commuter suburb of St. Louis - weak; (4) one-night occupancy check NOT POSSIBLE (no engine); Esri imagery (leaf-off) shows roughly 100 rigs packed into essentially every site of the north and west rows with no open sites visible - consistent with a park mostly let by the month; (5) not checked (no review text read). Test 4 is the open question: AWH may want a phone call asking whether overnight sites are kept open, or treat it as a drop candidate under the p3-313..316 'nearly every site occupied' pattern.
Pin OK: stored 38.8802,-90.7267 is the office lot off MO-79 (Google 38.88072,-90.72617); the RV rows centre ~150 m NE near 38.8814,-90.7262. Under the threshold.
